blurb: The Bay of Islands is situated on the west coast of Newfoundland. True to its name, its waters are dotted with islands of all shapes and sizes. And in the Bay of Islands, located on a peninsula below the mountains of the same names, you’ll find Blow Me Down Provincial Park; a gem of a camping destination. This park is as colourful as its name!
